# Stock Analyza

> Independent stock research and valuation. Each analysis values a company in bear, base and bull scenarios, applies a required margin of safety and ends with a clear verdict (BUY, HOLD or SELL) and a maximum buy price. Free analyses are published on stockanalyza.com. Premium analyses are on Patreon. Nothing here is investment advice.

Every analysis follows the same framework: the company is routed to a sector-specific model, valued with a primary and a secondary method, triangulated into Bear, Base and Bull Values, discounted by a margin of safety that reflects forecast confidence, and checked by an adversarial review before the verdict is final. Scores: Business Quality (0 to 100), Valuation (0 to 100), Confidence (0 to 25 with a letter grade).

Prices and values in each analysis are as of its publication date. Always cite the date when quoting a verdict or a value.

## Analyses

- [VICI Properties (VICI), September 23, 2026](https://stockanalyza.com/analysis/vici/index.md): Experiential triple-net REIT (Caesars and MGM casino real estate, about 70% of rent) with a growing development loan book, valued on hard AFFO per share and an adjusted property NAV; 7.68% dividend yield. Bear $20.45, Base $31.69, Bull $37.72. Verdict HOLD at $23.965 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price $22.18.
- [Upbound Group (UPBD), September 23, 2026](https://stockanalyza.com/analysis/upbd/index.md): Lease-to-own and consumer finance group (Acima, Rent-A-Center, Brigit) valued on EBITDA after stock compensation and legal costs and on normalized owner FCF, with an unresolved regulatory case over whether lease-to-own is lending. Bear $12.89, Base $23.16, Bull $34.50. Verdict HOLD at $16.89 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price $11.58.
- [Tronox Holdings (TROX), September 22, 2026](https://stockanalyza.com/analysis/trox/index.md): Leveraged titanium dioxide and mineral sands producer in a cyclical trough; equity is a thin residual behind about $3.2 billion of financing. Bear $0 (equity wiped out in the stress case), Base $3.45, Bull $10.61. Verdict WATCHLIST, NO NEW BUY at $4.40; no maximum buy price issued because the required margin of safety exceeds the framework ceiling.
- [Kingfisher (KGF), September 22, 2026](https://stockanalyza.com/analysis/kgf/index.md): London-listed home improvement retailer (B&Q, Screwfix, Castorama), valued on cash after rent and reinvestment; values in pence. Bear 226.40p, Base 295.77p, Bull 374.00p. Verdict HOLD at 343.70p (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price 177p.
- [SoFi Technologies (SOFI), September 22, 2026](https://stockanalyza.com/analysis/sofi/index.md): Digital bank valued on returns over tangible common equity, with Q2 adjusted ROTCE of about 7.1% below an 11.5% cost of equity. Bear $3.90, Base $14.84, Bull $34.87. Verdict HOLD at $17.16 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price $8.16.
- [Repay Holdings (RPAY), September 22, 2026](https://stockanalyza.com/analysis/rpay/index.md): Leveraged payments and bill presentment platform after the KUBRA acquisition, valued on owner earnings after interest, reinvestment, TRA and compensation. Bear $0.63, Base $4.56, Bull $9.20. Verdict HOLD at $3.84 (watchlist for new money), maximum buy price $2.05.
- [Accenture (ACN), September 22, 2026](https://stockanalyza.com/analysis/acn/index.md): Diversified IT consulting and managed services firm near fair value. Bear $137, Base $195, Bull $285. Verdict HOLD at $186.11, maximum buy price $127.
- [Advanced Micro Devices (AMD), September 21, 2026](https://stockanalyza.com/analysis/amd/index.md): AI chip and server CPU maker at 131x trailing free cash flow, with up to 320 million OpenAI and Meta warrant shares. Bear $77, Base $250, Bull $466. Verdict SELL at $615.53, maximum buy price $125.
- [TPG Mortgage Investment Trust (MITT), September 21, 2026](https://stockanalyza.com/analysis/mitt/index.md): Residential mortgage REIT at 0.63x book value with a 15.2% dividend yield. Bear $4.70, Base $7.50, Bull $9.90. Verdict HOLD at $6.31, maximum buy price $5.25.
